title: ceanothus franklinii

This shrub is native to California and is known for its vibrant blue flowers and medicinal properties. The bioactive constituents present in Ceanothus franklinii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
